notes.title: Sir Whoopass is now available on consoles!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=fg8gF5jFZYY;full][/previewyoutube]

Hold onto your asses and tighten your greaves — the wait is finally over! After years of sharpening swords, perfecting puns, and polishing armor to a dangerously blinding shine, Sir Whoopass: Immortal Death has officially landed on Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5!

That’s right, console peasants — rejoice! The world’s most questionable knight (and certified pun-warrior) is bringing his legendary blend of dad jokes, over-the-top combat, and questionable heroism to your couch, just inches from your snack-filled hands.

[b]Prepare to:[/b]
[list]
[*] Smack evil in Grööt's face with the BFS9000.
[*] Invite your friends for a true Co-Whooping experience.
[*] Solve puzzles that are only slightly less confusing than your uncle’s Wi-Fi password.
[*] Battle bizarre bosses, like a sentient lute and a guy named Sullivan who just really hates joy.
[/list]

And of course, you’ll go toe-to-toe (and pun-to-pun) with The Immortal, the game’s big bad who’s less “dark overlord” and more “drama queen with a vengeance.” Cursed with eternal life and eternal bad moods, this cape-flapping menace is determined to turn the world into one long Monday. He’s got a skull for a head, a chip on his shoulder, and a villain laugh so evil it’s been banned in 14 kingdoms for noise pollution.

[i]Sir Whoopass[/i] is not your average fantasy RPG — it's a glorious, ridiculous quest for vengeance, justice, and the last donut in the breakroom. Whether you’re a seasoned knight or just here for the puns, this is the console release you never knew you desperately needed.

So what are you waiting for? Saddle up, power on, and prepare to Whoop... some... ass.

Now available on Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5. Head over the their stores over here and check it out for yourself:

https://www.xbox.com/games/store/sir-whoopass-immortal-death/9njtnb9bq5ps

https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10010515

/Sir Whoopass team

notes.title: Performance Update: Now with 50% Less Rage-Quitting!
notes.content:
Hear ye, hear ye, brave (and occasionally frustrated) warriors of Sir Whoopass! We’ve read your feedback, felt your rage in every ALL-CAPS COMMENT, and witnessed your noble battles against the true villain of the game: [b]Lag.[/b]

After a mighty quest involving caffeine, bug-slaying, and no small number of spells (a.k.a. code fixes), we’ve summoned forth [i]The Lag-Slayer Update[/i]! Now, instead of jittering around like a caffeinated Orc Hipster on Cattucino, you’ll be gracefully gliding through battle at speeds even The Legendary Villain-Beating Artifact™ would envy.

What’s new, you ask? The optimizations mainly affects the Overworld which was the rage-quitting machine; here's a summary on what you can expect in this update:

[list]
[*][b]Smoothness & Stability:[/b] Fewer frame drops and higher framerate, so your sword swings look like deadly bullets. Reworked the Overworld to increase framerate and reduce memory usage.
[*][b]AMD Fixes[/b]: The 2nd biggest villain was AMD CPU's and GPU's which suffered an unnecessary amount. Now it should process as fast as a cowardly Orc Noob fleeing Sir Whoopass himself.
[*][b]Player movement[/b]: A "feature" allowed Sir Whoopass to move slightly less quick depending on camera angle - now you run with full grace no matter what camera angle.
[/list]
So dive back in, wield your mighty weapons and show those enemies what the Sir Whoopass experience feels like. And remember, fellow whoopers, keep the feedback coming. Who knows? We might just polish this game so hard it could pass as Sir Whoopass’s armor.

Happy slaying,
The Sir Whoopass Team 🏆

notes.title: Co-Whoop is finally here!
notes.content:
Fellow Whoopers, we have an announcement.

We've been secretly for the last couple of months developing an official co-op mode for Sir Whoopas; [b]Co-Whoop[/b]! The update is completely free and enables you to play the campaign [b]together with up to three friends[/b]. And oh yes, friendly fire is of course enabled by default!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38139983/4afa3bd11931f6dde0cfbc0757252a87abe6fd8d.jpg[/img]
Just enable co-op from the main menu and invite friends in the Steam Overlay, or tell them to Join your game, it's that simple. Any friend can join at any time and progress together with you in your current save game! The inventory is shared between players (don't spend all gold on Gnomes!) but you may equip any weapon, skin or apparel as you like.

[u][b]Here's a complete list of new features that is added in this major update:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Online and LAN co-op with up to 4 people
[*] Play the main story with (or most likely; against) your friends and solve puzzles together
[*] New multiplayer weapon [i]"Arcane Death Ray"[/i] only available in co-op
[*] New secret areas to find across the game
[*] New Sharp-Shooter Chicken enemy that spawns when you kill too many chickens (PTSD for all of you that played Ocarina of Time)
[*] Tweaked boss fights to be bypassable with a bit of creativity (for you speedrunners out there)
[*] Technical: Performance optimizations in the overworld
[*] Technical: Improved some VFX such as whoopass attack, dodge fx and various others
[*] Technical: New game config file (game.cfg) for you creative ones that want to tweak in-game values such as damage scale, number of enemies that spawns, player max level etc. (located in the savedata folder)
[*] Technical: Bug fixes and various improvements[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38139983/6dd759443e16dc78721dc1fe008536b3082c5b9b.jpg[/img]
Together with this update we are also launching [b]our very first DLC[/b]; [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3181710/Sir_Whoopass_Threads_of_Mass_Whoopery_Skin_Pack/]Threads of Mass Whoopery[/url] - an awesome skin pack that really will enhance your time together online (who wouldn't like to play as [b]Shkek[/b], [b]Donutello[/b] or [b]The Immortal[/b]?).

We will continue to update and keep the game relevant and are happy for your feedback! The easiest way to reach us is on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2Fd9YUJvthbv]our official Discord server[/url]. We are looking forward to see all havoc you may release upon your friends in this update; welcome to our Discord server to share those moments with us!

Until next time, 
Keep whooping!

notes.title: Streamer integrations!
notes.content:
Dear Whoopers,
We're adding external commands to Sir Whoopass!

That's right, we're handing out a magic wand for you - or maybe rather your viewers - to interact with the game by invoking commands that can trigger different stuff, such as(s):
[list]
[*] Make our hero small!
[*] Make him chunky!
[*] Make him slow as a turtle!
[*] Make him drunk!
[*] Spawn different kind of enemies!
[*] Spawn companions (new feature in-game!)
[*] Set him on fire!
[*] Set off a shark attack (our favourite)
[*] ..and more!
[/list]
There are 40+ different commands available that can be triggered either through Twitch chat, or through Streamloots cards ([url=https://www.streamloots.com]https://www.streamloots.com[/url]), to level up the streaming experience with Sir Whoopass.

Read more about how to set it up, and all available commands over here:
[list]
[*] For Twitch: [url=https://atomicelbow.com/twitch]https://atomicelbow.com/twitch[/url]
[*] For Streamloots: [url=https://atomicelbow.com/streamloots]https://atomicelbow.com/streamloots[/url]
[/list]

Some time during March there will also be an "Original Collection" for Sir Whoopass available on Streamloots, so keep an eye out for that!

Until next time,
Stay tuned and have an ass-whooping day.

/Sir Whoopass team

notes.title: FREE Demo OUT NOW!
notes.content:
That's right all you doubters, cheapskates, and smart-spenders out there:
- Now you can dip your toes into the zany world of Sir Whoopass before you purchase the game!

The Demo features the first missteps of our Hero's journey. If you manage to beat it there is a pot of gold waiting for you at the end of the rainbow should you choose to purchase the full version.

- And the best part? You won't even have to replay the first part of the game (that's included in the demo), one quick swipe with the credit card and you'll be back right where you left off.


OH yeah, I almost forgot: We also launched the performance update, so no more burning GPUs for my fellow toaster-gamers!

notes.title: Huge performance update + DEMO launching Soon™
notes.content:
No longer does your GPU have to catch fire in order to kill some orcs and save the world, with our new performance update the game will run A LOT better and also enable those of you playing on toasters to enjoy the misadventures of Sir Whoopass without smelling burnt toast.


And that's not all - We're also releasing a DEMO for all you cheap try-before-you-buyers to see what we're about! Come dip your toe into Sir Whoopass' weird corner of the world, no spoilers but there is definitely a pot of gold waiting for you at the end of that rainbow. 

Changes go live on [b]October 27th![/b]

notes.title: Localization and other major updates!
notes.content:
[b]Hello Whoopers![/b]
We are finally ready to showcase [b]our next major update (version 2.1.0)[/b] that we have been working on for the past month!

We've taken notes from the reviews, forums and discord. From that we've prioritized what we think will make the game better for most players, and then.. we did it! Here's a list of what we've done:

[h1]⭐Localization support![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38139983/9a93010d2339e15e3b2b12785c0c424e06e338d7.png[/img]

Yes, we have finally added support for more languages, so our non-english speaking friends can enjoy Sir Whoopass as well. Currently supported languages are:
[list]
[*] English
[*] German
[*] French
[*] Spanish
[*] Brazillian-Portugese
[*] Simplified Chinese
[/list]Please let us know if any of your native speakers has a more proper translation for any part or aspect of our game; we'd love to improve further upon its appearance so all of you can enjoy it the fullest :)


[h1]⭐Redesign of the dodge attack![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38139983/e3bb684b4929429569aaed23d143b24f877fdd22.gif[/img]

We noticed that many of you didn't use the [b]dodge mechanic[/b] as often as we anticipated and took the opportunity to redesign it. It has always been intended as an offensive action, and not a defensive action as it often is in other games.

Think of it more as a [b]dash attack[/b] than a dodge. We enhanced it's appearance and tweaked the impact of it. We also added a specific enemy, Orc Commander, that only can be defeated by using the attack to give some more variation in the combat system. Happy dashing!


[h1]⭐New flying mini-game[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38139983/c985aaa48e876c4d83818451c557a26513f5f202.gif[/img]

Weehoooo! The [i]Coming Soon™[/i] feature in the Overworld has now finally come! Scattered around the landscape are some [b]golden ruins[/b] that contains a golden pipe. These pipes leads the player to a new area where you can fly around and collect loot, as well as being knocked down by annoying enemies. Just the way you like it!

Be sure to make your way all up to the top to collect some new highly appreciated loot. There are six dungeons of this kind in the landscape and all are randomly generated to give you players each an unique puzzle to solve.


[h1]⭐New end-game boss fight[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38139983/b4551fd0db11c9631ae7be5a2ebe48dd6e0a6dc0.gif[/img]

Be ware of the dragon*!
[i][b]Eggs? Zapp? Spoink? What?[/b][/i]

The Immortal finally decides to release the dragon in a more controlled environment to defeat Sir Whoopass, once and for all!

This has been a long requested feature; we've seen that many of you that have finished the game have been dissatisfied with the ending, and felt that there should be a final boss in the game. Now there is, hope you enjoy!

How will it eventually end though? Fire it up and find out!


[h1]⭐New features[/h1]
[list]
[*] UI scale (choose between 80% - 120%)
[*] HoverCraft can now honk
[*] 2 new achievements
[/list]

[h1]⭐Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Steam Deck improvements!
[*] Tooltips have been improved to be much more noticeable. We've been watching your playthroughs on Twitch and seen that some players sometimes miss the tooltips when they are engrossed in combat or other action. Hopefully that will happen a lot less now.
[*] Whoopass attack UI has been revamped. We've added a new HUD element for the whoopass attack, located right below the health bar.
[*] Quest UI has been improved, now you'll get better feedback when a subquest is completed.
[*] Puzzles in Overworld have been improved, now each of the sliding puzzles have a unique image.
[*] More cheese!
[*] Leveling curve adjustment we noticed many players reached max level a bit too quick, so we've adjusted it slightly.
[*] The Bard in Jolly Barrel Inn is now a bit more fun :)
[*] Removed the slow-motion cutscene that would sometimes play when killing the last enemy in an encounter
[*] Throwables can now be thrown a bit further
[*] Added reminders to use dodge and throwables if the player forgets to use them
[*] New sounds for some enemies
[*] New effects and tweaked animations for dodge and throw to make the combat more fluid
[*] Improved dodge and block tutorials
[/list]


[h1]⭐Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed crosshair sometimes coming back after being disabled
[*] Fixed an issue where players sometimes couldn't close the end game stats screen in sewer level
[*] Fixed an issue where a cheese in Ancient Ruins of Moldy Ceiling could not be collected
[*] Fixed an issue where an encounter in Cave of Stuffed Pantrys not could be defeated
[/list]

That's All Folks!

Have Fun!

/Team Atomic Elbow


[i]* Wyvern.[/i]

notes.title: Sir Whoopass 2.0 - Community feedback edition!
notes.content:
Hello Whoopers!

The time has finally come to show you what we've been working on the last month - our first MAJOR UPDATE!

We've taken notes from the reviews, forums and discord. From that we've prioritized what we think will make the game better for most players, and then.. we did it! Here's a list of what we've done:


[h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38139983/5aaca63cc26ffbb7674f326847f3885d89360017.png[/img]Main Quest Redesign[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38139983/e02bb5476f2ae18d982e28e0af55e700ce05bb68.png[/img]
We noticed some players did not enjoy getting all the dungeons at the same time. It was difficult to understand which dungeons had to be completed before others. We've grouped the dungeons so that it's clearer which challenge they belong to, and added new quest objectives to reflect that. TL:DR; Less confusion, more fun! 


[h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38139983/5aaca63cc26ffbb7674f326847f3885d89360017.png[/img]Improved Overworld[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38139983/f6f4cfd7874edca983203aaea3f656a3db5fe196.png[/img]
We've added lots of new stuff, for example:
[list]
[*] new things to interact with to gain loot and powerups
[*] 20+ new camps
[*] a new area to explore!
[/list]
On the forums, we've also heard that people think the respawn rate in the Overworld is too high, so we've halved it. Now you have more time to explore before the whooping starts again!


[h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38139983/5aaca63cc26ffbb7674f326847f3885d89360017.png[/img]Optimization[/h1]
The Overworld is also the area that most players have had performance issues, especially those with slower CPUs. So we've done some work there - playing on a Ryzen 3600 or similar processor (3 y/o, midrange) with a decent GPU should now give you around 60 fps in the overworld on Medium settings.


[h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38139983/5aaca63cc26ffbb7674f326847f3885d89360017.png[/img]Improved Dungeons[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38139983/c353877d68a56467b01810866dc138bd8ce21f77.png[/img]
A lot of players have commented that the game becomes repetitive in the later parts of the game. Because of this, we're overhauled all of the dungeons with lots of new stuff to increase variety and replayability. Here are some of the changes:

[list]
[*][b]Stats:[/b] Every dungeon now has stats, such as time taken enemies killed, secrets found, etc. You'll see the new stats screen when you exit a dungeon
[*][b]Continue:[/b] Destroying an energy orb no longer automatically exits the levels. Instead, a portal will open - when you go through this you'll get the stats screen. There you can choose if you want to keep on playing (in case you missed some stuff), or exit the dungeon.
[*][b]Secrets:[/b] Every dungeon now has secrets! This includes collectibles, easter eggs and secret walls. 
[*][b]Lucy-activated traps:[/b] Another comment was that Lucy was not being utilized very much in the game. So we added special traps that Lucy can activate, to be used against the enemies!
[*][b]Exploding barrels:[/b] before, these were mostly found in the overworld. Now you can use them in dungeons as well! We've placed them strategically so keep an eye out for them!
[*][b]Loot chest placement improvements:[/b] Some loot chests had awkward placements, we've moved them around for more fun moments!
[*][b]Orb Guardians:[/b] There was not really many enemies protecting the energy orbs, a bit weird since they're what's protecting The Immortal from his enemies. So now we've amped up the security; each orb is protected by mini-boss guardians.
[*][b]Traps:[/b]There are more traps in the dungeons to keep you on your toes!
[/list]

[h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38139983/5aaca63cc26ffbb7674f326847f3885d89360017.png[/img]Flappy Knight Arcades[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38139983/d38f5c21b5e67bf0c0f2b20e38dd3e5941040bb4.png[/img]
That's right! You can now get that sweet retro feeling, playing the old-school classic Flappy Knight in the arcade halls hidden all around the game! Four differents arcades can be found. 

There are two modes, one that rewards you with a golden chest if you complete it, and another endless mode where you simple earn as many points as possible, competing with other Flappy Knight players for the top spot on the Steam Leaderboards!


[h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38139983/5aaca63cc26ffbb7674f326847f3885d89360017.png[/img]Continue Game[/h1]

notes.title: Halloween is coming to town!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38139983/358e3d77b984c3487582331a3facf3e3600e7412.png[/img]

[h1]Get ready to whoop some more ass![/h1]
Halloween is just around the corner and Sir Whoopass finds himself caught in the middle of a Brothers Grimm adventure. How he ended up there is of course unknown, just like the majority of the game's story.

Set your reminder and get ready for this year's halloween update! Below is a summary of what to expect in the upcoming update! 

[h2]🎃New quest![/h2]
Aid Little Red Riding Hood in reaching her grandmother safely. Our hero stumbles upon her outside a dark and scary forest, filled with Big Bad Wolves and poisonous spiders. Is that a... [b]flamethrower[/b] in her hand? You have to play it yourself to find out what it is all about!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38139983/8e7fd8c6741527bfeb5d672428f8040a87bc7e92.jpg[/img]

[h2]🎃New limited time only loot![/h2]
There's halloween-themed loot you can only get during this event! The first item that is lootable is the [b]Jack-o'-lantern[/b], which when equipped, has a chance to drop candy from all enemies killed. Yummy and Trick or treat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38139983/630cf64a27c5bb99c259257b843945822fb0a461.jpg[/img]

The "hat" is lootable as a reward in the end of the new Halloween level; accessible through a giant pumpkin outside Stonedale. How you may ask? Jump straight in and find out for yourself, but something tells us that it has to do with an elderly grandmother...

The other loot is a new Halloween skin (read below!).

[h2]🎃New skin support![/h2]
Every hero needs a way to disguise itself for various occasions, this game is no exception!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38139983/4df0f73a971f2f5692d08a42d25996a4e2ec8268.jpg[/img]

Visit the newly opened [b]"Pimp My Protagonist"[/b] workshop just outside Stonedale to get yourself suited in various outfits. This initial release is shipped with six different skins:
[list]
[*] Default Sir Whoopass look
[*] Gimp outfit
[*] Orc noob outfit
[*] Halloween outfit [b](granted during this event [u]ONLY[/u])[/b]
[*] Halloween gimp outfit [b](granted during this event [u]ONLY[/u])[/b]
[*] Halloween blue outfit [b](granted during this event [u]ONLY[/u])[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38139983/080db606eb3c68508d7263c3fc0ab928a3f1749c.jpg[/img]

As more updates roll out, we are planning to release more outfits for you to try out! Do you have any outfit you'd like to see in the game? Comment below and we may consider your ideas when designing new outfits! Happy suiting!

[h2]🎃New dragon*![/h2]
Our dragon* has been very busy at work lately but we decided to finally let it stretch its wings for a first maiden voyage in the sky!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38139983/71c7012da3447a9472f3b2a791ca1cd73d2592c9.jpg[/img]

The dragon* spawns after a while then The Immortal grows tired of our hero's achievements in the world. You better watch out for its fire balls!

[i]* Actually, it's a wyvern.[/i]

[h2]🎃New halloween look to Stonedale![/h2]
The spiders and witches unfortunately couldn't keep their hands off our beloved town, Stonedale.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38139983/58f68c4ea33ad0368d3f4958d07f3dcb1d0c6d8e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38139983/6e9d44c203b588367928b8c664437acf081cada9.jpg[/img]

Luckily for us, the local folks (and cats) seems to be happy and thankfully dressed up for the occasion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38139983/d608f86964e4ac9e5009361275ca3a8718938ab9.jpg[/img]

Some destructibles also changed appearance to scary pumpkins for our protagonist to destroy. Happy pumpkin smashin'!

That is this update in a pumpkinshell! As always we encourage you to leave your feedback and thoughts about the game and we read all of your comments! Until next time! 🎃

notes.title: Controller is coming
notes.content:
Hey all !

Finally, we have released the game. It felt both scary and awesome at the same time. But so far, we couldn't have wished for a better reception! Many seem to like the game and that make our hearts warm :-) We also try to capture suggestions and feedback on how to improve the game.

So, what happens now ?

Initially, we are going to try to keep the developer streaming going on at the store page, that helps to keep the buzz going a bit and keep us closer to the surface at Steam :)

In parallel with this, we are going to focus on some low hanging fruits that can ease up the game play a bit.
[list]
[*] Skeleton cave is HARD, we want to remove some bad guys in there. 
[*] After having been up to the bridge, teleport the player right back to Melisande instead of having to run
[*] Inverted mouse support
[*] Some SFX volume adjustments
[/list]

..these things should be quick fixes and will be done as soon as possible in an update.

After that, we want to aim at two bigger things (besides more smaller ones): Controller support and memory usage.

[list]
[*] Controller support
Many have requested this, more than we expected. We had planned this for a major update in six weeks, but due to the high demand we will try to brush this one off faster. 
[*] Memory usage
We have gotten aware of some crashes and high/extreme memory usage. That's unfortunate of course, very sorry about this. This can be a trickier one to fix though, but we're going to deep-dive here too!
Our best tip right now to everyone having problems with memory and/or crashes is to lower the graphics settings - avoid "Ultra" if it causes problems for example.
[/list]

We want to thank you all for your kind words, constructive feedback and suggestions! Keep whooping while we keep improving the game ! See ya soon :)

notes.title: A first update
notes.content:
Hey all!
Yes, we are still alive and working hard on [b]Sir Whoopass - Immortal Death[/b] (SWA).

We have received great reponse on our teaser trailer - better than we could hope for, and that makes us very happy. :-) Thanks alot!
 
Many have asked, and we feel compelled to share some information with you all - so here are some Q&A:

[b]Q:[/b] Will it be released in 2020?
[b]A:[/b] So far, we have announced the release of SWA "soon", or told you "fall 2020", or said "in the end of 2020". However, this has changed. We want to create a great game, and we felt that our initial plan for the game was a bit too rushed, and it wouldn't make the game turn out as good as we would want it to be. So we won't be able to release it in 2020 - we're really sorry about that. The current goal for 2020, however, includes to get a gameplay trailer out, and to get some serious beta testing going on.

[b]Q:[/b] When will it be released?
[b]A:[/b] Our new, still somewhat fuzzy, goal is to get it out during the earlier part of 2021.

[b]Q:[/b] Will it be a full release?
[b]A:[/b] No, it will be released in parts/chapters. We have yet to decide the specific details on this maneuver.

[b]Q:[/b] Will it be in [i][language that is not English][/i]?
[b]A:[/b] No, probably not. The plan right now is to release it in English. Future updates might add additional languages though.

[b]Q:[/b] Is that the cyclops from Dragon's Dogma?
[b]A:[/b] No. But they're similar (oh and also - our cyclops is actually Mexican).

[b]Q:[/b] Is that a dragon or a wyvern?
[b]A:[/b] Yes! ;-)

Again, thanks for all the feedback so far, it really helps us keeping motivated in our quest to get Sir Whoopass out to you guys!
